registration.statement: An enthalpy-equivalent chemical state is the complete held composition, molecular state, phase and environment carrier whose exact positive content composes admitted internal energy with every retained organized environment-transfer part. If no such part is generated its place is structural EmptyOne. State orientation is held separately from exact positive separation.
